questions.q: In 'The Pace for Living', why does R.C. Hutchinson feel a sense of despair in the Dublin theatre?
options: Because the tickets were expensive
Because the actors were bad
Because he cannot keep pace with the rapid changes of scenes and characters
Because the play was in French
questions.explanation: लेखक धीमी गति से सोचने के कारण नाटक के तेजी से बदलते दृश्यों और पात्रों को समझने में असमर्थ रहता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does Joan Lexau's 'Me and the Ecology Bit' suggest about human psychology regarding environmental laws?
options: People want to pay more taxes
People love picking garbage
People hate trees
People enthusiastically preach ecology to others but resist changing their own convenient habits
questions.explanation: लोग दूसरों को पर्यावरण का उपदेश देते हैं पर खुद अपनी आरामदायक आदतें नहीं बदलना चाहते।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Gillu', what deep bond is established between Mahadevi Varma and the squirrel?
options: A bond of silent empathy, love, and mutual companionship across species
A temporary bond
A commercial bond
A master-servant bond
questions.explanation: लेखिका और गिल्लू के बीच मूक संवेदना, प्रेम और आत्मीय साहचर्य का गहरा संबंध स्थापित होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does Satyajit Ray view as the primary hurdle for Indian cinema's global recognition in his essay?
options: The lack of theatres
The lack of money
The lack of electricity
The lack of imaginative integrity and over-reliance on imported, un-Indian storylines
questions.explanation: भारतीय निर्देशकों में कल्पनाशील सत्यनिष्ठा का अभाव और विदेशी कहानियों की अंधी नकल मुख्य बाधा है।
questions.subject: English
questions.chapter: What is Wrong with Indian Films

questions.q: In 'Acceptance Speech', what does Alexander Aris emphasize about the relationship between peace and democracy?
options: That democracy is secondary to wealth
That true peace cannot exist without the guarantee of democratic freedoms and human rights
That peace is bought with money
That peace requires military dictatorship
questions.explanation: अलेक्जेंडर एरिस बताते हैं कि लोकतांत्रिक स्वतंत्रता और मानवाधिकारों के बिना सच्ची शांति संभव नहीं है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is Toni Morrison's central argument regarding 'oppressive language' in 'Once Upon a Time'?
options: It is only found in books
It helps children learn faster
It is beautiful and necessary
It represents violence and functions to limit human knowledge and subjugate the vulnerable
questions.explanation: दमनकारी भाषा हिंसा का रूप है जो ज्ञान को सीमित करती है और कमजोरों का शोषण करती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'The Unity of Indian Culture', how does Humayun Kabir explain the concept of 'assimilation'?
options: The process by which foreign cultural elements are absorbed and transformed into an integral part of Indian heritage
The total destruction of foreign cultures
The complete isolation of India
The rejection of all new ideas
questions.explanation: विदेशी सांस्कृतिक तत्वों को अपनाकर उन्हें भारतीय विरासत का अभिन्न अंग बना लेना ही समन्वय (assimilation) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What moral lesson is derived from the climax of Tolstoy's 'Little Girls Wiser Than Men'?
options: That Easter is only for feasting
That water puddles are dangerous
That mothers should always fight
That adult conflicts are often driven by false pride, while children possess the innate wisdom of quick reconciliation
questions.explanation: बड़ों के झगड़े झूठे अंहकार पर आधारित होते हैं, जबकि बच्चों में तुरंत एक होने की स्वाभाविक प्रज्ञा होती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How does R.C. Hutchinson illustrate the speed of modern life in 'The Pace for Living'?
options: By describing computer processors
By contrasting the slow, agrarian lifestyle of the corn-merchant with the 1,000-mile-an-hour aeroplane
By talking about bullet trains
By measuring river currents
questions.explanation: लेखक अनाज व्यापारी के धीमे ग्रामीण जीवन की तुलना 1000 मील प्रति घंटे की रफ्तार वाले हवाई जहाज से करता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the underlying ironic message in 'Me and the Ecology Bit' when Jim's mother points out his TV usage?
options: That environmental consciousness must begin with self-regulation before lecturing others
That Jim is a great teacher
That electricity is free
That TV is good for ecology
questions.explanation: पर्यावरण के प्रति जागरूकता दूसरों को उपदेश देने से पहले स्वयं के आत्म-नियंत्रण से शुरू होनी चाहिए।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Cowper's 'God Made the Country', what contrast is established between the natural canopy of trees and urban structures?
options: Trees are dangerous, buildings are safe
Trees produce artificial light
Trees offer unpolluted, revitalizing shade, whereas urban structures trap noise, smoke, and artificiality
Buildings grow naturally
questions.explanation: पेड़ शुद्ध और सुखद छाया देते हैं, जबकि शहरी इमारतें शोर, धुएं और बनावटीपन को कैद करती हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What represents the ultimate state of blessedness in Alexander Pope's 'Ode on Solitude'?
options: Traveling across the globe
Becoming a famous politician
Amassing huge treasures in a city
Living entirely self-sufficiently on one's own land, unburdened by public fame or societal expectations
questions.explanation: अपनी जमीन पर पूर्णतः आत्मनिर्भर होकर बिना किसी सामाजिक या सार्वजनिक दबाव के जीना ही परम सुख है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How does Durga Prasad Panda use the imagery of the 'polythene bag' to explore human trauma?
options: By showing that bags are beautiful
By showing that trauma disappears in water
By showing that suppressed psychological trauma, like non-biodegradable plastic, refuses to decompose and periodically releases toxic emotions
By showing that plastic is a great invention
questions.explanation: पॉलीथिन की तरह ही दबा हुआ मानसिक आघात कभी नष्ट नहीं होता और समय-समय पर जहरीली भावनाएं छोड़ता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Vidyapati's 'Thinner Than a Crescent', what does Radha's extreme physical emaciation signify?
options: Her lack of food in the village
Her anger toward her friends
Her desire to look beautiful
The immense physical and spiritual toll of acute unrequited longing and separation from the divine
questions.explanation: राधा की क्षीणता श्रीकृष्ण से तीव्र विरह और मिलन की असीम तड़प के शारीरिक और आध्यात्मिक प्रभाव को दर्शाती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What philosophical critique of materialism is offered in Periasamy Thooran's 'The Empty Heart'?
options: That gold is the only source of permanent joy
That trees are meant to be cut
That the relentless pursuit of material wealth creates an insatiable internal void that ultimately destroys human health and peace
That rich people live forever
questions.explanation: भौतिक धन की अंधी दौड़ मनुष्य के भीतर एक ऐसा खालीपन पैदा करती है जो उसके स्वास्थ्य और शांति को लील जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Puran Singh's 'Koel', what is the metaphorical significance of the Koel's blackened body?
options: It represents a soul scorched by the intense, all-consuming fire of separation from the beloved
It represents dirty rain water
It represents the natural dark color of night
It represents coal from a mine
questions.explanation: कोयल का काला शरीर प्रियतम के विरह की तीव्र और भस्म कर देने वाली आग से झुलसी हुई आत्मा का प्रतीक है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How does Laxmi Prasad Devkota portray the dignity of labor in 'The Sleeping Porter'?
options: By showing him fighting with tourists
By juxtaposing the porter's grueling, sub-human mountain climb with his sublime, tranquil sleep beneath the cosmic starry sky
By making him a rich landlord
By giving him a modern vehicle
questions.explanation: कवि कुली की हाड़-तोड़ चढ़ाई की तुलना तारों के नीचे उसकी असीम और शांत नींद से कर उसके श्रम को गौरव देता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Walter de la Mare's 'Martha', what is the psychological effect of Martha's storytelling on the child listeners?
options: It prepares them for math exams
It makes them aggressive and loud
It makes them bored and sleepy
It induces a state of hypnotic trance, transporting them to a serene, mythical realm of fairies and gnomes
questions.explanation: मार्था की कहानियाँ बच्चों को सम्मोहित कर परियों और बौनों की एक अत्यंत शांत, जादुई दुनिया में ले जाती थीं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What poetic technique is masterfully employed by William Cowper in 'God Made the Country' to emphasize his theme?
options: Antithesis (sharply contrasting rural divine creation with urban human fabrication)
Hyperbole only
Alliteration only
Onomatopoeia only
questions.explanation: कवि ग्रामीण ईश्वरीय सृष्टि और शहरी मानवीय निर्माण के बीच तीखा विरोध (Antithesis) स्थापित करता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the central moral warning in Periasamy Thooran's 'The Empty Heart'?
options: That Kalpaka trees are dangerous
That greed is a bottomless pit that blinds a person to the true blessings of life until it is too late
That one should always ask for eight pitchers
That gold is better than silver
questions.explanation: लालच एक ऐसा अंधा कुआं है जो मनुष्य को जीवन के वास्तविक सुखों से तब तक वंचित रखता है जब तक मौत न आ जाए।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Premchand's 'January Night', what does Halku's final decision to warm himself by burning leaves signify?
options: His temporary triumph of primal survival over his domestic financial anxieties
His desire to burn the orchard
His plan to kill the nilgais
His hatred for his dog
questions.explanation: सूखी पत्तियां जलाकर ठंड दूर करना हल्कू की आर्थिक चिंताओं पर उसकी प्राथमिक जीवित रहने की इच्छा की जीत है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What medical and social insight is provided by Dr. Rana S.P. Singh in 'Allergy'?
options: That allergies can be cured by eating sugar
That allergies are purely magical curses
That allergies only affect old people
That allergies are complex biological responses influenced by both genetic predisposition and modern environmental pollutants
questions.explanation: एलर्जी एक जटिल जैविक प्रतिक्रिया है जो आनुवंशिक कारणों और आधुनिक पर्यावरणीय प्रदूषण दोनों से प्रभावित होती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Chekhov's 'The Bet', what profound transformation occurs in the lawyer during his 15-year confinement?
options: He evolves from a worldly, ambitious man into a spiritual ascetic who rejects material wealth and human vanity
He learns how to rob banks
He loses his memory completely
He becomes a cruel criminal
questions.explanation: 15 वर्षों में वकील एक महत्वाकांक्षी पुरुष से बदलकर सांसारिक धन और अंहकार को ठुकराने वाला संन्यासी बन जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is John Galsworthy's ultimate critique of modern industrialism in 'Quality'?
options: That advertisement is the best art
That shoemakers are lazy
That modern machines make better shoes
That mass production and aggressive advertising crush dedicated, uncompromising artisan craftsmanship
questions.explanation: मशीनी उत्पादन और आक्रामक विज्ञापन सच्चे, समर्पित और गुणवत्ता-प्रेमी हस्तशिल्प को कुचल देते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Katherine Mansfield's 'Sun and Moon', what does the destruction of the pink ice pudding house symbolize?
options: The shattering of childhood innocence and beauty by the careless, consumerist adult world
The joy of eating ice cream
The end of winter season
The poor cooking skills of the chef
questions.explanation: गुलाबी पुडिंग वाले घर का टूटना बड़ों की लापरवाह और उपभोगवादी दुनिया द्वारा बच्चों की मासूमियत को ठेस पहुँचाना है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What dynamic between traditional endurance and modern autonomy is depicted in Bina Pani Mohanty's 'Two Horizons'?
options: Both women want to become politicians
The mother embodies silent, enduring sacrifice, while the daughter seeks self-respect and modern individual identity
Both women hate writing letters
The mother is modern, the daughter is old
questions.explanation: माँ मौन त्याग की मूरत है, जबकि बेटी आत्मसम्मान और आधुनिक व्यक्तिगत पहचान की तलाश में है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Giridhar Jha's 'Love Defiled', what is the psychological flaw that precipitates the narrator's downfall?
options: His fear of his parents
His lack of education
His extreme poverty
His overweening ego and career elitism, which blind him to the priceless worth of unconditional love
questions.explanation: वक्ता का अहंकार और पद का घमंड उसे प्रेमिका के निस्वार्थ और अनमोल प्रेम को देखने से अंधा कर देता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the symbolic role of the dog Jabra in Premchand's 'January Night'?
options: He represents a wild nilgai
He represents the cruel landlord
He represents unconditional loyalty and the shared suffering of man and beast against harsh natural elements
He represents wealth and luxury
questions.explanation: जबरा वफादारी और कड़ाके की ठंड के खिलाफ मनुष्य और पशु के साझा संघर्ष और दुख का प्रतीक है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How does Anton Chekhov build tension in the climax of 'The Bet'?
options: By showing a loud gun fight
By contrasting the banker's desperate, murderous greed with the sleeping lawyer's sublime, written renunciation of the millions
By introducing a police raid
By making the house catch fire
questions.explanation: बैंकर के लालच और हत्या की योजना की तुलना वकील के त्याग-पत्र से कर चेखव कहानी में अद्भुत तनाव पैदा करते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the central tragic irony in John Galsworthy's 'Quality'?
options: That Mr. Gessler cannot speak German
That Mr. Gessler becomes the king of London
That Mr. Gessler makes the finest boots in London but dies of starvation because he refuses to compromise on quality or spend on advertising
That Mr. Gessler hates boots
questions.explanation: त्रासद विडंबना यह है कि गेसलर लंदन के सर्वोत्तम जूते बनाते हैं पर विज्ञापन न करने और गुणवत्ता से समझौता न करने के कारण भूखे मर जाते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the one word substitution: A person who looks at the bright side of things.
options: Atheist
Optimist
Pessimist
Pacifist
questions.explanation: आशावादी व्यक्ति को 'Optimist' कहा जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the one word substitution: A person who looks at the dark side of things.
options: Optimist
Sadist
Artist
Pessimist
questions.explanation: निराशावादी व्यक्ति को 'Pessimist' कहा जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the one word substitution: A life history of a person written by himself.
options: Biography
History
Autobiography
Calligraphy
questions.explanation: स्वयं लिखी गई अपनी जीवनी को आत्मकथा (Autobiography) कहते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the one word substitution: A life history of a person written by another.
options: Biography
Autobiography
Geography
Bibliography
questions.explanation: किसी अन्य व्यक्ति द्वारा लिखी गई जीवनी को 'Biography' कहते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the one word substitution: A piece of land surrounded by water on all sides.
options: Continent
Island
Valley
Peninsula
questions.explanation: चारों ओर पानी से घिरे भूभाग को द्वीप (Island) कहा जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the one word substitution: A person who does not believe in the existence of God.
options: Atheist
Theist
Priest
Saint
questions.explanation: ईश्वर के अस्तित्व में विश्वास न रखने वाले को नास्तिक (Atheist) कहते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the one word substitution: A person who believes in the existence of God.
options: Atheist
Agnostic
Heretic
Theist
questions.explanation: ईश्वर में विश्वास रखने वाले को आस्तिक (Theist) कहते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the one word substitution: That which cannot be read.
options: Legal
Eligible
Illegible
Infallible
questions.explanation: जिसे पढ़ा न जा सके (अस्पष्ट लिखावट), उसे 'Illegible' कहते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the one word substitution: That which cannot be corrected or reformed.
options: Incorrigible
Inviolable
Incredible
Incurable
questions.explanation: जिसे सुधारा या ठीक न किया जा सके, उसे 'Incorrigible' (असंशोधनीय) कहते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the one word substitution: A government by the people, of the people, and for the people.
options: Anarchy
Democracy
Autocracy
Monarchy
questions.explanation: जनता के लोकतांत्रिक शासन को 'Democracy' (लोकतंत्र) कहा जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Transform the sentence by removing 'too': He is too slow to win the race.
options: He is so slow that he cannot win the race.
He is so slow to win race.
He is too slow that he cannot win.
He is very slow to win the race.
questions.explanation: 'too... to' को 'so... that + subject + cannot/could not' में बदला जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Transform the sentence by removing 'too': The box was too heavy for me to lift.
options: The box was too heavy that I could not lift.
The box was so heavy that I cannot lift.
The box was so heavy that I could not lift it.
The box was very heavy for me lift.
questions.explanation: Past Tense (was) होने के कारण 'could not' का प्रयोग होगा और 'for me' 'I' बन जाएगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into Comparative degree: Ram is as tall as Mohan.
options: Mohan is taller than Ram.
Ram is taller than Mohan.
Mohan is not tall than Ram.
Mohan is not taller than Ram.
questions.explanation: Positive degree सकारात्मक होने पर Comparative नकारात्मक (not taller than) बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into Positive degree: Iron is more useful than any other metal.
options: Very few metals are as useful as iron.
Any other metal is as useful as iron.
No other metal is as useful as iron.
Some metals are as useful as iron.
questions.explanation: 'than any other' वाले वाक्यों का Positive 'No other... as... as' से बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into Superlative degree: No other building in the world is as beautiful as the Taj Mahal.
options: The Taj Mahal is the most beautiful building in the world.
The Taj Mahal is a most beautiful building.
The Taj Mahal is beautiful building.
The Taj Mahal is more beautiful building.
questions.explanation: 'No other' वाले वाक्यों का Superlative 'the + superlative degree' से बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into Comparative degree: Very few Indian kings were as great as Ashoka.
options: Ashoka was greater than any other Indian king.
Ashoka was greater than most other Indian kings.
Ashoka was greatest king.
Ashoka was great than most kings.
questions.explanation: 'Very few' वाले वाक्यों के Comparative में 'than most other' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Transform the sentence by removing 'too': She is too proud to beg.
options: She is very proud to beg.
She is so proud to beg.
She is so proud that she will not beg. / she cannot beg.
She is too proud that she cannot beg.
questions.explanation: अर्थ के अनुसार 'will not beg' या 'cannot beg' का प्रयोग बिल्कुल सही है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into Positive degree: Gold is heavier than silver.
options: Silver is not heavy than gold.
Silver is not as heavy as gold.
Silver is heavier than gold.
Silver is as heavy as gold.
questions.explanation: दो वस्तुओं की तुलना में Comparative से Positive बनाते समय 'not as... as' लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into Superlative degree: Kolkata is bigger than most other cities in India.
options: Kolkata is the biggest city in India.
Kolkata is a biggest city in India.
Kolkata is biggest cities in India.
Kolkata is one of the biggest cities in India.
questions.explanation: 'than most other' वाले वाक्यों का Superlative 'one of the + superlative + plural noun' से बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Transform the sentence by removing 'too': It is never too late to mend.
options: It is never too late that one cannot mend.
It is never so late that one cannot mend.
It is never so late to mend.
It is never very late to mend.
questions.explanation: यह एक प्रसिद्ध कहावत का मानक रूपांतरण है: 'It is never so late that one cannot mend.'
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He is an M.A. in English.
He is M.A. in English.
He is the M.A. in English.
He is a M.A. in English.
questions.explanation: 'M.A.' का उच्चारण स्वर (Vowel - एम) से शुरू होता है, अतः 'an' लगेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
options: I prefer milk from tea.
I prefer milk than tea.
I prefer milk over tea.
I prefer milk to tea.
questions.explanation: 'Prefer' (वरीयता देना) के साथ हमेशा 'to' preposition लगता है ('than/over' गलत है)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
options: One of my friends is a doctor.
One of my friends are a doctor.
One of my friend is a doctor.
One of my friend are a doctor.
questions.explanation: 'One of + Plural Noun (friends) + Singular Verb (is)' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He told to me that he was going to Patna.
He told me that he was going to Patna.
He told me that he is going to Patna.
He said me that he was going to Patna.
questions.explanation: 'Told' के बाद 'to' नहीं लगता और Past Tense के साथ 'was going' लगेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He has been living here for five years.
He has been living here since five years.
He is living here since five years.
He is living here for five years.
questions.explanation: अनिश्चित समयावधि (five years - Period of time) के लिए Present Perfect Continuous में 'for' लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Neither Ram nor his friends has come.
Neither Ram nor his friend have come.
Neither Ram nor his friends have come.
Neither Ram nor his friends is come.
questions.explanation: 'Neither... nor' में Verb पास वाले Subject (his friends - Plural) के अनुसार 'have' लगेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Although he worked hard, and he failed.
Although he worked hard, so he failed.
Although he worked hard, but he failed.
Although he worked hard, yet he failed.
questions.explanation: 'Although' के साथ हमेशा 'yet' का जोड़ा बनता है ('but' का प्रयोग पूर्णतः गलत है)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
options: She is more beautiful to her sister.
She is more beautifuller than her sister.
She is more beautiful than her sister.
She is most beautiful than her sister.
questions.explanation: 'Beautiful' का Comparative 'more beautiful' होता है; डबल comparative (more beautifuller) गलत है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
options: If I was a bird, I would fly to you.
If I were a bird, I would fly to you.
If I were a bird, I will fly to you.
If I am a bird, I would fly to you.
questions.explanation: काल्पनिक शर्त (Subjunctive mood) में 'If I were...' के साथ 'would + V1' लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
options: The sceneries of Kashmir are beautiful.
The scenery of Kashmir are beautiful.
The scenery of Kashmir is beautiful.
The sceneries of Kashmir is beautiful.
questions.explanation: 'Scenery' अनकाउंटेबल Noun है; इसका Plural (sceneries) नहीं बनता और Verb Singular (is) रहता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: जैसी करनी वैसी भरनी।
options: As you sowing, so reaping.
As you sow, so you reap.
Like you sow, like you reap.
As you sow, so shall you reap.
questions.explanation: यह अंग्रेजी की एक अत्यंत प्रसिद्ध लोकोक्ति (Proverb) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: डूबते को तिनके का सहारा।
options: A drowning man catches at a straw.
A drowning man catches a straw.
A drowning man looking for straw.
A drowning man catching straw.
questions.explanation: यह अंग्रेजी का सटीक और मानक मुहावरेदार अनुवाद है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: ताली एक हाथ से नहीं बजती।
options: It takes two for clapping.
It takes two to make a quarrel.
Clapping not done by one hand.
It takes two to clapping.
questions.explanation: 'It takes two to make a quarrel' (ताली एक हाथ से नहीं बजती) एक मानक लोकोक्ति है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: जो गरजते हैं वो बरसते नहीं।
options: Barking dogs seldom bite.
Barking dogs do not bite.
Barking dogs never bite.
Thundering clouds never rain.
questions.explanation: यह अंग्रेजी का सटीक और मानक मुहावरेदार अनुवाद है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: लालच बुरी बला है।
options: No vice like greediness.
No vice like avarice. / Greed is a curse.
Greed is very bad.
Greed is bad thing.
questions.explanation: यह एक प्रसिद्ध कहावत है: 'No vice like avarice.' या 'Greed is a curse.'
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the synonym of 'Candid'?
options: Deceptive
Rude
Frank / Honest
Secret
questions.explanation: 'Candid' (स्पष्टवादी/खरा) का पर्यायवाची 'Frank' या 'Honest' है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the antonym of 'Vigilant'?
options: Watchful
Careless
Alert
Cautious
questions.explanation: 'Vigilant' (सतर्क/सावधान) का विलोम 'Careless' (लापरवाह) होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the synonym of 'Obstinate'?
options: Gentle
Docile
Stubborn
Flexible
questions.explanation: 'Obstinate' (जिद्दी/अड़ियल) का पर्यायवाची 'Stubborn' है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelt word:
options: Fasinating
Fascinating
Fascinatingg
Fashinating
questions.explanation: 'Fascinating' (आकर्षक) की सही स्पेलिंग 'Fascinating' (Fas-cin-at-ing) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelt word:
options: Simultanous
Simulteneous
Simultaneous
Simultanios
questions.explanation: 'Simultaneous' (एक ही समय में होने वाला) की सही स्पेलिंग 'Simultaneous' (ta-ne-ous) है।
